desc: This COMFEE' 0.7 Cubic foot 700-watt microwave oven features convenient one-touch cooking, 11 power levels, a mute button, and a removable turntable in a compact footprint to fit in a cabinet or on the counter. The large LED digital display has a clock function and can also display a kitchen timer as well as the cooking time remaining. Includes an energy-saving ECO mode where the LED display can be turned off. A convenient mute button turns off the microwave beeps for quiet operation. Its smaller size is ideal for apartment kitchens, vacation homes, offices, or dorms.
